name: Langham Hotel, Melbourne
positioning: Riverside Southbank hotel, officially The Langham, Melbourne, with a Waterford crystal lobby chandelier and daily afternoon tea
best_for: Travelers who want a riverside base a few minutes' walk from the city center
Groups wanting a two-bedroom apartment-style stay

facts.text: The hotel is riverside in the Southbank precinct, a few minutes' walk from the city center.
Even the most modest guest rooms have marble bathrooms with generous tubs.
Deluxe Balcony Rooms have a balcony for sunsets and cityscapes.
The Langham Club offers private check-ins, refreshments and a workspace for private meetings.
Executive class rooms are on higher floors and give access to the Club Lounge for free breakfast, drinks and canapes.
Melba is the hotel's flagship restaurant and serves a grazing buffet at lunch and dinner.
The afternoon tea uses specialty tea from the British tea brand JING.
Condé Nast Traveler Readers' Choice Awards listed the hotel in 2018, 2019, 2020, 2021, 2023, 2025 and 2026.

highlights.text: The hotel lobby chandelier is custom-made with Waterford crystal.
Aria Bar & Lounge serves afternoon tea seven days a week.
In 2013 the hotel began a partnership with illustrator Kerrie Hess, whose art is exhibited in the hotel.
The Residence by Kerrie Hess is a private apartment with a lounge and dining area, two bedrooms, two marble bathrooms and a kitchen.

considerations.text: The lobby can get congested around the 12 p.m. checkout.
The rooms are fairly traditional, with floral carpets and plenty of cream tones.
WhataHotel notes a formal atmosphere that may not suit all travelers.

sources.title: Condé Nast Traveler: The Langham, Melbourne review
